colorado-edu-innovate-getseedfunding.title: Get Seed Funding | Innovation & Entrepreneurship Initiative
colorado-edu-innovate-getseedfunding.description: Get Seed Funding (GSF) is a CU Boulder program, hosted by the Innovation & Entrepreneurship Initiative, that provides micro-funding for undergraduate and graduate students with entrepreneurial ideas in the making. Run by a student-led team, GSF hosts weekly pitch sessions where applicants present their ideas and can be awarded up to $500 in seed funding to move projects forward. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and reviewed by the GSF team, making it easy to jump in at any stage of your journey.

colorado-edu-venturepartners-2023-10-24-.description: Through the Lab Venture Challenge (LVC), top innovations from CU Boulder, Denver and Colorado Springs compete for grants of up to $125,000.
